description: Référentiel des lignes de transport en commun d’île-de-France is a dataset listed in prim.data.iledefrance-mobilites.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ile-de-France Mobilités. Liste des lignes commerciales de transport en commun (train, RER, métro, tramway, bus et car) circulant en Île-de-France. Documentation Une documentation relative aux référentiels de transport d'Île-de-France Mobilités est disponible. Coverage: Île-de-France (Île-de-France Mobilités network). The portal files it under Arrêts et lignes du réseau. Its keywords are Métro, Train, RER, Bus, Tramway, Lignes. The portal shows 1,940 records. The portal shows 2021-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-prim-stif-portal.
